purpose: Plan explicit side-effect observations for public reduce and reduce-kv operand evaluation; supplemental to, and not a replacement for, the original seven #245 cases.

existing_case_mapping.source: (do (def reduction-trace 0) (reduce (do (set! reduction-trace 1) +) (do (set! reduction-trace (+ (* reduction-trace 10) 2)) 0) (do (set! reduction-trace (+ (* reduction-trace 10) 3)) (list 1 2))) reduction-trace)
existing_case_mapping.relevance: Same public three-argument reduce call; the returned decimal effect code encodes function, init, collection order as 123. It does not cover two-argument reduce or return a distinct trace vector.

existing_case_mapping.operation: public reduce-kv, three arguments, fallback collection
existing_case_mapping.source: (let [trace (atom []) outcome (try (reduce-kv (do (swap! trace conj :fn) (fn [_ k _] (swap! trace conj k) (throw :fallback-boom))) (do (swap! trace conj :init) :initial) (do (swap! trace conj :coll) kv-fallback-sample)) [:returned] (catch :default error [:thrown error]))] [outcome @trace])
existing_case_mapping.relevance: Same public reduce-kv entry point and explicit fn/init/coll side effects, but it targets fallback dispatch and throws on the callback. It is not evidence for the ArrayMap/record dispatch branch in #245.
Not treated as public reduce coverage: the query invokes cljs.core/-reduce directly.

supplemental_cases.source: (let [trace (atom []) result (reduce (do (swap! trace conj :fn) (fn [acc x] (swap! trace conj [:call acc x]) (+ acc x))) (do (swap! trace conj :coll) [1 2]))] [result @trace])

(let [trace (atom []) result (reduce (do (swap! trace conj :fn) (fn [acc x] (swap! trace conj [:call acc x]) (+ acc x))) (do (swap! trace conj :init) 10) (do (swap! trace conj :coll) [1 2]))] [result @trace])

supplemental_cases.operation: public reduce-kv, three arguments, one-entry ArrayMap
supplemental_cases.source: (let [trace (atom []) result (reduce-kv (do (swap! trace conj :fn) (fn [acc k v] (swap! trace conj [:call acc k v]) (+ acc v))) (do (swap! trace conj :init) 10) (do (swap! trace conj :coll) (array-map :only 3)))] [result @trace])

execution_boundary: Do not include these cases in the original seven-case acceptance corpus. First capture each exact source on the pinned ClojureScript revision, then host-decode Suss results in Runtime and Macro; do not infer operand order from callback traces alone.
